dedupe_keys.name: agriculturaldigitaltwinplatform digital twins for small agricultural holdings iaaa lab

description: An open-source platform for building digital twins of small farms. The GitHub README says the platform supports fast development of digital twins for small agricultural holdings, with a pistachio use case, and cites Laguna et al. 2025 in Computers in Industry volume 172, article 104347; the case study ran two field twins on a machine with 2 vCPU and 4 GB of RAM. The code is free to download under the MIT licence. Coverage is the farms a user configures, with Spanish fields in the case study. Caveats: the page read does not give data sources for other regions or maintenance status. For simulation it offers a light framework to connect field sensor, weather and crop data to a twin that can show how drought or heat affect a holding. A related catalogue record is the Agromonitoring Agro API.
